messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a clean handoff runbook + SLA spec for GA. Who has final ownership for each piece?
Jorge: I'll take the SLA draft and perf targets. current thinking: p95 < 250ms gen, p99 < 700ms for 8k tokens on Dedicated. Need input on fallback tiers.
Sasha: I'll own monitoring & alerting. Questions: what are SRE paging thresholds vs paged-but-not-oncall alerts?
Li: Support will own the escalation matrix + runbook steps for common errors (OOM, model mismatch, tokenization errors). Need sample logs and actionable next steps.
Nina: Docs will do the public "GA readiness" checklist + internal runbook. I'll need owners for screenshots, sample requests, and any cli/SDK changes.
Owen: Pricing needs banded tiers for throughput and on-demand vs reserved. Proposal: baseline per-token + throughput discount for Dedicated commitments. Need the expected qps ranges to model unit economics.
Maya: High level sections I want in the runbook: SLA table, monitoring/SLOs, failover policy, support playbook, docs links, pricing/limits, legal/compliance flags, rollout plan + canary gates.
Jorge: Draft SLA snippet (will paste into doc):
```
SLA: Availability (hosted API): 99.95% monthly uptime
Latency: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 700ms (generation under typical 8k token workload)
Support: Standard (email/console) response < 4 business hours; Premium (phone/SL) < 1 hour
Credits: Service credits prorated for SLA breaches >4h
```
Sasha: Suggestion: separate "performance" SLOs (latency/throughput) from "availability" SLA. For paging: page on error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency >1.5s for 5m. Otherwise create low-priority alerts.
Li: I'll need a short triage checklist to paste into Zendesk macros. Example lines: 1) Collect request_id + model + variant; 2) Check kv-cache hit rate; 3) Confirm fallback model used; 4) Escalate to eng if reproducible by customer.
Nina: For external docs: we should include an "limits & pricing" section + best-practices for cost/latency tradeoffs (batching, kv-caching, recommended quantization). Internal runbook needs play-by-play commands: `redwood ctl traces get <req>` and how to pull logs from Dedicated pools.
Owen: For pricing models: propose 3 buckets: pay-as-you-go (hosted), committed Dedicated (monthly RU commit), enterprise custom (private). Need to finalize token cost and throughput pricing by next Tues to hit sales enablement.
Maya: Can we also capture rollback criteria for a bad rollout? e.g., error rate >2% or revenue-impacting latency regressions for 15m -> automatic fallback to previous model variant.
Jorge: We can gate canary with these metrics: error rate, p99 latency, and downstream queue depth. Deploy-bot: canary scheduled for 1765080000 - please run smoke tests.
Deploy-Bot: Canary scheduled by @Jorge for 1765080000. Smoke checks: healthcheck, sample-gen sanity, cost-estimator smoke.
Sasha: Action items (owners):
- SLA doc + rollback criteria: Jorge (due in 48h)
- Monitoring & alert thresholds + runbook: Sasha (due EOD+2)
- Support playbook + macros: Li (due EOD+1)
- External GA docs + quickstart: Nina (due EOD+3)
- Pricing finalization + example calculators: Owen (due next Tue)
Maya: Great. I'll consolidate into a single GA handoff doc and set a follow-up sync at +72h. Please add any missing dependencies (legal signoff, compliance checklist). :thumbsup:
Li: One more ask — training doc for support on the new Dedicated behaviors (caching, quotas). Nina, can we collaborate?
Nina: Yep — I'll pair with you tomorrow.
Jorge: I'll drop the SLA markdown into the shared doc and link perf dashboards.
Sasha: I'll add runbook playbooks and test alert noise thresholds (trying to avoid paging for transient blips).
Maya: Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark this thread as the canonical handoff and update the product board.
Owen: No objections from pricing. We'll lock numbers after Jorge's qps ranges.
Maya: Closing note — owners, please update the doc header with your name and final due date. We'll review during the 72h sync.
